spans.text: Zdravstvuyte, Commander. Griffin unit Makarov salutes you.
Though this mission is a disgrace in itself, it is my honor to serve under your command.
Hey, what do you mean, 'a disgrace'?! You're to rescue a veteran with very venerable history!
As you can see, this is our rescue target this time - a T-Doll designated 'Nagant M1895'.
You probably already know her... Or should I say, you can't possible NOT know her...
Haha, why would the commander not know me? Remember how our friendship burgeoned on the very first battlefield?
You probably find it hard to understand the point in rescuing such an old, weak, noisy and commonplace T-Doll.
Hey, watch it! Or I'll appeal to Gospozha Helian to demote you! A demotion, you hear?!
However, during our last operation, she inadvertently discovered an important object that needs to be brought to HQ post-haste.
Hurry up already, Makarov! I'm still holed up in a Sangvis warehouse!
Nagant M1895, do you remember the number of the warehouse? Or at least give me some description to work with.
I told you. I rushed right in so I didn't pay attention. It's crawling with Sangvis mechanical units outside. I'm dead meat if I go out!
(Sighs) Then please stand by. We'll come as quickly as we can.
In any case, let's make our first move.
As Griffin's main forces are aiding in a military operation, we are severely understaffed here.
We'll have to join up with the T-Dolls stationed in the area and rely on their assistance.
Commander, please guide us on our way.
